holollamaPath.selectedExecutablePolicy: must include build-holo/bin and must not select bare PATH, .docker/bin/inference, legacy llama.cpp/build/bin, or Ollama-owned llama-server

constraint.role: grammar/constraint identifier for constrained native .holo generation; not semantic proof

attempts.modelPath: HoloLlama constrained path (dry receipt, no inference server launched)
attempts.prompt: Generate a minimal .holo proof object for Joseph that compiles before render promotion.

compile.reason: parse failed, so compile/render promotion was blocked

repairLoop.action: close the composition/object braces and preserve the same intent under the grammar constraint

attempts.modelPath: HoloLlama constrained path (dry receipt, no inference server launched)
attempts.prompt: Repair attempt-1 into valid HoloScript without claiming runtime/render semantics.

semantic.reason: parse and WebGPU compile succeeded, but no browser render, screenshot, CAEL, SimulationContract, or founder-facing proof surface was run in this T3 receipt

promotionPolicy.invalidSyntax: reject before compile or render work
promotionPolicy.validSource: promote only after parse and compile proof
promotionPolicy.semanticSuccess: must remain not_proven until T4 proof-surface evidence exists
